name: CRC-atlas primary CRC Xenium and IMC spatial cohorts
source: BioImage Archive; Cancer Cell supplementary Table S1
tissue: primary CRC core, margin and adjacent normal
modality: Xenium targeted spatial transcriptomics plus IMC
fields_checked: patient table;sample index;matrix and cell-table filenames;380-gene panel
notes: The full Xenium archive is about 299 GiB, but first-pass matrices/cell tables/analysis objects are about 0.37 GiB. Eleven of 15 spatial patients have a linked scRNA patient ID, so this is not wholly independent. It supports primary niches only; the panel omits many malignant-program genes and does not provide a CRLM spatial series.

notes: Response metadata exist for 106 patients and RECIST for 78, but regimens and studies differ and this is not an independent bulk outcome cohort. It is a source for selecting coherent subcohorts, not a pooled response contract.
